Iris (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — VantageMed signed a 45-day pilot via Azure Marketplace private offer. They want Redwood Private in their VNet for structured discharge notes + anonymization. Big channel win with PartnerQ. :tada:
Jon (Sales): Awesome. Offer ID AM-33022. Pilot billing via Marketplace; upsell to Dedicated if pilot metrics look good.
Hana (Eng): Tech checklist: deploy in their subnet, ensure Private Link endpoints, confirm KMS integration, and pin model versions. Need sample workload for perf sizing.
Maya (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff scheduled Thu 1pm PT. Customer asked for a short case study if pilot succeeds and permission to co-publish metrics.
Jon (Sales): Target expansion KPIs: p95 < 95ms, throughput 200 qps @256 seq, anonymization precision > 0.91. Looping PartnerQ manager.
Iris (Partnerships): ContentBot reserved a case study slot. Ops ticket created for onboarding artifacts. Shoutout to Jon and Hana for the rapid close. Reply here with blockers. :rocket:
